Empires of Black Powder is a Napoleonic RTS with card-based army building and direct combat on horseback. Assemble your regiments in camp, command infantry, cavalry and artillery in real-time battles, and take control of your commander to fight alongside them. The troops you bring home form the army you take into the next battle.

BUILD YOUR ARMY

Open packs to recruit troops and find equipment for your regiments. Sell unwanted cards, use spare copies to promote your favorites, and decide where to spend your gold.

Another pack could give you the cavalry your army needs, but replacing losses in your veteran infantry might matter more before the next engagement.

COMMAND INFANTRY, CAVALRY AND ARTILLERY

Deploy infantry in line for firepower, use columns to move quickly, and form squares against cavalry. A square can stop a charge, but leaves your men vulnerable to cannon fire.

Protect your artillery, send cavalry around exposed flanks, and watch your troops’ morale before committing them to another fight. Coordinate your regiments so each can cover the others’ weaknesses.

FIGHT FROM HORSEBACK

Take direct control of your mounted commander in first or third person. Fight with saber and pistol, block incoming strikes, and rally nearby troops.

Issue orders from horseback as the battle develops, directing regiments into position while you support them in person.

PREPARE YOUR POSITION

Send Pioneers to gather timber and build fieldworks, gun positions and powder magazines. Choose where to establish your defenses and how much to commit before advancing.

Magazines replenish your army’s powder supply, but your regiments still carry a limited supply of shot. Decide when to keep firing, when to hold, and when to close with the enemy.

KEEP YOUR VETERAN GUARD ALIVE

Casualties carry between battles. Review your regiments’ service records, replenish their ranks, and improve the equipment of the units you want to take further.

Gold spent replacing losses is gold you cannot spend on new packs. Protect your veterans and bring them into the next battle. Three defeats end an expedition, so recovering from a costly victory is part of the campaign.

TAKE ON HARDER CAMPAIGNS

Complete the campaign to unlock the next difficulty and choose cards to carry forward.

Progress from Rookie through Veteran and Marshal to The Emperor Himself, facing stronger armies and more demanding enemy tactics with less powder to spare.

Empty House is an online co-op survival horror game for up to 4 players. You are part of a vaccine retrieval crew sent into a zombie-infested zone. To fill your vaccine quota, you must enter abandoned houses crawling with zombies. Find the vaccines with your teammates and bring them back to the base.

Cover yourself in zombie blood and step into the horde



Smear zombie blood on your body and mimic the way they walk. If the zombies in front of you mistake you for one of their own, you can walk right through the horde. Keep walking with confidence, even when you want to run. Just get out before your disguise wears off.

Learn which zombie you're facing



Not every zombie falls for your act. Keep your footsteps quiet around sound-sensitive zombies, and shine your flashlight on zombies that freeze in the light. Learn the traits of the zombies you encounter in abandoned houses and use that knowledge to make your way through.

Gather oil for the next abandoned house



Put the scrap you bring back into the base's grinder to extract oil. Oil is the fuel you need to reach the next abandoned house and the currency for buying gear. Decide with your teammates whether to buy more equipment or save enough oil for the next abandoned house. There are still more places to search for vaccines.

Go in together. Come back together.



Finding the vaccines doesn't finish the job. You still have to carry them back through the zombies to the base. Use a variety of gear and help each other meet the quota. If you think you can make it through the horde alive, return to the base with your teammates.

Your Story

Congratulations on your graduation from command school, but now you face a problem. No one is going to hire a green, rookie commander, to a permanent position on one of their stations...

Its time to get some experience under your belt and begin building a name for yourself.

Fortunately you have inherited a derelict mining station, its not much but its a start. There are also plenty of corporations and even pirate factions that will employ you in the short term to take charge of a situation, where no better alternative is available.

Gameplay

Take command from your own ship to lead wings of fighters, bombers, destroyers and even powerful capital ships against enemy forces. Salvage parts from the wrecks of destroyed ships to upgrade to your ship and the ships of your wing leaders...

Based out of a long forgotten outpost hidden inside an asteroid field, build up a fleet of mining and salvage ships to provide you with the resources that you will require. Then build new and more powerful ships, assign a small fleet to defend your base against incursions by pirates and then begin taking on contracts.

Rescue additional pilots to take control of up to 4 additional wings. Each pilot can be equipped, upgraded and will then accompany you on contracts providing much needed support and special abilities. Set individual orders for them or bring everyone together in a single fleet.

Take a look at the job board for a list of available contracts. Contracts of various types will become available as your renown and level increases. Station defence and repairs, convoy escorts, strikes on enemy stations, espionage, and more.

Killing enemy ships and completing contracts grants experience, resources and loot, equip looted systems into your own ship to enhance its power and even recover new ship hulls, unlocking more weapons and utility slots as well as more powerful shields and armour. Or share the spoils with your companions and take on harder contracts for bigger rewards.

This is your chance, all you have to to is take it!

Leave the game running to farm loot, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

Endless Battle: Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game featuring 8 skills, 4 enhancements… a wealth of equipment effects to customise, and unique support companions with distinctive mechanics.

Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing.

If you find it too difficult, don’t worry. Withdraw decisively, sell the items and gear you’ve acquired, and use the proceeds to purchase upgrades to strengthen your character.

A friendly reminder!

  • Every time you reach a certain floor, the rewards you receive upon withdrawal will be boosted.

  • The battle continues even when the game is closed (unless you weren’t on the battlefield when you logged out XD), so remember to launch the game the next day to collect your rewards!

  • The tech tree offers all sorts of amazing features to help you grind more easily and enjoyably—do pop in every now and then to have a look.

Build your own pinball table

Every run starts from scratch. Between stages you buy bumpers and drag them onto the table wherever you want them. Where they sit decides how the ball travels, how your combos chain, and how long you survive.

Combine and discover

Two bumpers make a new one. A coin bumper and a timer bumper become something neither of them was. You only find out what a recipe produces by building it once — and from then on it stays unlocked for good, across every future run.

Five worlds, five bosses

Each world has its own table, its own backdrop and its own boss who steals your lives and your bumpers. Beat them to unlock new balls.

Six balls, six rule sets

Every ball plays differently and bends different rules. Only the first one is yours from the start — the rest you take from the bosses.

Perks

Small items with a lasting effect on your current run. Some work quietly in the background, others save you exactly once. What you find is up to the shop.

Endless mode and leaderboards

Stage 50 is not the end. Keep going and measure yourself against everyone else on the leaderboard — each ball has its own ranking, and your best run is listed there with its time and score.

Endless Canvas is a puzzle‑exploration game blending infinite zoom, hidden‑object hunting, jigsaw puzzles, codes, and logical deduction, set within paintings. Inside this white picture frame lies an endlessly expanding realm of microscopic wonders. Every zoom will carry you into an unknown world within the painting; every solved puzzle brings you closer to the secrets hidden within.

Gameplay Features

Adopting a two‑layered gameplay design, the game delivers an immersive puzzle‑solving experience:

  • Inner Puzzles · Gather Clues: Dive deep inside artworks and tackle a wide variety of mini‑games, including jigsaw puzzles, hidden‑object hunts, spot‑the‑difference, code challenges, and mechanism unlocking. Complete them to obtain vital clues or items leading to the next world inside the painting.

  • Outer Exploration · Locate Portals: Follow clues and search within paintings for the “portals” to the next painted world.

    • Logical Deduction: Analyze visual and textual riddles, locate concealed portals and uncover secrets within the painting;

    • Make Use of Items: Cleverly employ your collected items to discover hidden secret doors within the artwork;

    • Passage by Placement: Place various items onto designated spots in the painting. Piece together patterns, cover blemishes or replace visual elements, alter the scene before you, and open pathways toward new worlds;

    • Code Deciphering: Observe visual details closely, interpret clue cards, crack the correct level‑sequence code, and escape this surreal zooming image maze!

Game Description

Deeply blending the classic elements of idle and tower defense games, this game offers rich hero and equipment build options. Hands-free and hassle-free, enjoy the joy of strategic combination and effortless growth!

Please Note

This game contains extensive equipment grinding elements. Players who do not enjoy grinding for gear are advised to purchase with caution!!!

Game Features

  • Auto Battle
    Fully hands-free with auto-battle mode — level up and hunt for loot at the same time.

  • Numerous Heroes
    40 unique heroes allow you to build diverse lineups and explore various playstyles.

  • Hero Equipment
    Random combinations of dozens of ability affixes make every drop and forge a moment of anticipation!

  • Varied Modes
    Beyond idling, enhance your overall strength through colonies, dragon battles, expeditions, fortresses, and other distinct gameplay modes.

  • Stress-Free
    No penalties for defeat — simply wait for your power to grow and try again. No enemy is unbeatable!

Endless Dark Loot is a dark-fantasy card-style RPG all about the thrill of the loot.

Dive into dungeon after dungeon, fight hordes of demons, and grab tons of gear and skills along the way. Every run is a fresh adventure — and every drop could flip your whole strategy on its head.

Loot first, build second.

Combat is just the opener. The real fun kicks in after the fight. Every piece of gear and every skill you pick up could be the missing piece of your next killer build.

Crit build? Lifesteal? Cooldown? Elemental damage? It's all up to you. Mix and match skills and gear to find your perfect combo — and the next dungeon is always waiting to put it to the test.

Easy to pick up, play anytime.

Super simple to get into — you'll get it in seconds. But every drop comes with random stats and affixes, so you never know what surprise the next piece of gear is hiding.

No grind required. Play when you want, stop when you need. Jump in anytime — and walk away with something good every single time.

Key Features:

  • Card-Style Vibe — Heroes and monsters all shown as slick collectible cards. Progress feels clear and satisfying.

  • Endless Loot Loop — Every run brings fresh drops. Random skills and gear stats mean there's always something better around the corner.

  • Build Your Own Way — Tons of skills and gear to mix and match. Crit, lifesteal, elemental, cooldown — your build, your rules.

  • Easy to Learn, Hard to Quit — Simple controls, but the build combos are endless. Keeps every run feeling new.

  • Play Forever — No finish line. Just better gear, deeper dungeons, and that one perfect build you're always one drop away from.

One goal: build your ultimate loadout, then loot until you've had enough.

In Endless Loot, you explore in first person, fight for better gear, and decide what to keep before heading down another floor. A single drop can give you a reason to rethink your whole build.

Every click takes a turn

Walk up to a group of monsters, then click the one you want to attack. Ready skills from the books you've activated in your bag fire automatically. Surviving enemies strike back when their turn comes up, so choosing which one to hit first matters.

Two of a kind make an upgrade

Merge two copies of the same item at the same grade to make a stronger one. Equip pieces with matching traits to unlock set bonuses, and spend gold at merchants when a drop hasn't filled the gap.

Turn spare gear into lasting power

After a biome boss, you can sacrifice one piece of equipment at the exit and keep its base stats for the rest of the run. Is that spare weapon worth saving for an upgrade, or would you rather take the stats now?

Finish the campaign or keep going

Clear the campaign or descend through repeating biomes in Endless mode, with new floor layouts, stronger enemies and better loot. Between runs, unlock heroes and invest in their own upgrade trees.

Endless Valkyrie is a Nordic mythology 2D side-scrolling pixel idle RPG. Lead a Valkyrie through frozen wilds and ancient ruins as she explores ever onward through the realms connected by the World Tree. She moves, selects targets, attacks, and casts skills automatically. Your decisions shape the run: configure her gear, skill rotation, and long-term growth path to determine how far she can go.

  • Automatic exploration and combat: The Valkyrie advances to the right, encounters enemies, selects valid targets, and fights without constant input. Once an encounter is cleared, she keeps moving. Turn auto-battle off at any time to stop movement, attacks, skills, enemy behavior, and spawning.

  • A skill loop you control: Equip three skills, set their priorities, and toggle automatic casting for each slot. Combat state, valid targets, conditions, and cooldowns all matter, giving you meaningful decisions without demanding constant control.

  • Loot worth comparing: Collect equipment from battle, compare ratings and random affixes, and refine your build as stronger or better-suited drops appear.

  • Journey through ten themed regions, from the Frozen Wilds and Crystal Cave to the Ruin Castle and beyond. Face distinct enemies and regional bosses, clear each region to unlock the next, unlock new skills as you reach higher floors, and push your limits in a separate Greater Rift challenge.

  • Flexible skill loadouts: Build around Holy Strike, Divine Guard, Valkyrie Blessing, Frost Nova, and Lance Thrust. Fill three slots, tune their priority, and manage casting conditions and cooldowns.

  • Six equipment rarities: Common, Fine, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythic gear come with random affixes and equipment ratings, making every drop a potential upgrade or collection piece.

  • A 40-slot inventory: Filter, sort, compare, equip, lock, sell, and dismantle your items. Rare-and-better gear and manually locked items are protected, while Mythic gear cannot be mishandled.

  • Forging and permanent growth: Spend gold and Crystal Energy Fragments to forge stronger equipment. Use Soul Crystals to improve permanent stats such as attack, health, defense, gold gain, and drop rate.

  • A shop for battle supplies: Once unlocked, the shop offers healing potions, rune potions, and featured equipment so you can prepare for the next push.

  • A rebirth cycle: Rebirth when you meet the requirement to convert progress into Soul Crystals and reset the current run, while keeping permanent upgrades and your skill configuration for a stronger next start.

  • Offline Rewards: Step away and return to a limited cache of estimated gold, materials, and representative equipment. Claim the rewards and continue the progression loop.

  • A 16-bit pixel world: Fight beneath auroras and mountain skies, through ruins and along the World Tree, with layered parallax scenery and readable combat effects.

Every automatic battle can uncover better gear, and every regional challenge opens another path to growth. Configure your skills, manage your inventory, forge your equipment, and choose the right moment to rebirth. Guide the Valkyrie along the road ahead and create a combat rhythm that is uniquely yours.

My ordinary life as a freshman in the Literature Club suddenly began to unravel one day.

Yeah, that notebook...

About This Game

<Entered> is a retro-style horror visual novel set in a high school literary club.

You take the role of a new club member and experience a series of strange incidents unfolding within the club as the story progresses.

Your choices determine the path ahead, branching into multiple routes where entirely different horrors and truths await.

Each route explores a different horror subgenre—psychological horror, mystery, occult horror, and more—while the fates of the characters and the endings change accordingly.

What exactly has "entered"?

Find out for yourself.

Features

• Retro CRT monitor-style 4:3 aspect ratio

• 256-color VGA pixel graphics with scanline effects

• Extensive use of FMV-style video sequences

• A visual novel where the story changes based on player choices

• Multiple horror experiences spanning psychological horror, mystery, occult horror, and more

• Character fates and endings that vary depending on the route

(The demo includes one complete route from beginning to end!)

You awaken in a dying world where nearly anything is possible, and you don't know how to do any of it (yet).

A storyteller decides what happens in your game, based on how you play. You pick from 3 storytellers: the Keeper, the Warden or the Harbinger. The Keeper protects your habits. The Warden incentivizes changing them. The Harbinger punishes them. Some examples:

  • Natural disasters and catastrophes, what kind, and where. Earthquakes, meteor strikes, firestorms.

  • Quests and encounters it thinks would interest you.

  • Political strife that may happen to you, or near you.

You can talk to anyone

Type whatever you want! NPCs answer in character based on their trade, their mood, and your past actions. A local, lightweight language model runs on your own machine (no account, no internet needed) and is grounded by roughly 100,000 written lines of dialogue so the world and its people stay in character and know what they should know. It talks; it never acts, and the game tells you what really changed.

If your PC can't run it, a written conversation menu covers every quest. Khaldurim is an isolated, cynical Dwarven stronghold. Show up as an Elf and the gatekeepers will treat you accordingly. Same gate, same clerk, not the same welcome.

The world doesn't forget

There is no ending and no victory screen. People remember what you did, and word travels: what one person saw first-hand and what the town only heard are different things to them. The world state tracks your footprint for as long as you play, which can be a very long time.

The simulation doesn't wait for you

  • Living economy: Settlements produce goods: mines mine as deep as they can go, villages harvest building materials, farms maintain crops. Caravans buy the extras, and sell the settlement what they can't make on their own.

  • Organic expansion: Settlements and worksites actually grow. When the population outgrows the tavern, the tavern adds a floor.

  • Politics: Settlements run on charters and upkeep. Miss the payments and the place reverts to someone who will make them. The world map shows who holds what.

  • Real logic circuits: Wire automated machinery or assemble a working computer. You can make a screen, calculator, or automation for just about anything you can think of.

  • Realistic mining: Ceilings collapse without support beams, and what falls, and from how high, decides what it does to you.

  • Five powerful deities: Each represents a unique domain of power, and offers powerful abilities to their followers. These relationships take a mix of appeasement, maintenance and a lack of hubris. If any of these are not enough for their favor, the abilities are gone.

  • Farming & livestock: Enclosed animal pens and functional field laborers, tied directly to local food stocks. Farms maintain crops that grow in stages, and you can watch them harvest.

  • Unforgiving enchantments: You can enchant anything, with anything. Enchant a leaf with a pickaxe, and see what happens. Consequences range from a stronger weapon to your own gravity turning over.

  • Persistent devastation: Meteors, tremors, and severe weather leave real terrain scars that never despawn.

  • Harmonics: A local tavern card game where the townsfolk are more than happy to stake their unique collections against your coin.

Difficulty is about information, not damage sponges

  • Casual: Clear UI callouts and extensive tooltips explain systems as they happen.

  • Intermediate: Expects you to figure out mechanical interactions through experimentation.

  • Complex: Logs only what you have personally witnessed, closes the tutorials, and stops holding your hand.

Modding

Items, blocks, crafting recipes, structures, and encyclopedia entries are structured data files. Add your own content without needing to dig into core source files. Modding tools are planned.

Early Access vs. The Full Game

Early Access gives you a village start, the overworld, and the furnished part of Khaldurim, the Dwarven mountain city: seven hand-drawn districts. The rest of the city, and the rest of the continent, which is much larger, arrive in updates.

Bring the world back to life after the greatest extinction

Earth's greatest mass extinction devastated ecosystems on land and in the oceans. The surviving lineages of animals and plants began to repopulate an emptied world.

In Epoch Vault, you will reconstruct the history of the Mesozoic, from the earliest survivors in the aftermath to the age of giant dinosaurs.

Discover, develop, restore

Gather Data, uncover new creatures and key events, upgrade the records you have restored, and progress through the three phases of each period.

Every restored record increases your income and brings you closer to the next discovery. Passive income continues to accumulate while the game is closed. When you return, invest the Data you have gathered, expand the tree, and continue your research.

Restore the Tomes of the Mesozoic

Within each Tome, individual discoveries come together to tell the story of an entire period. The branches of the tree explore the creatures, ecosystems, and changes that reshaped the Earth:

  • survivors of the mass extinction and the recovery of ecosystems;

  • ancient animals, plants, and marine communities;

  • the rise of dinosaurs and pterosaurs;

  • marine reptiles and other inhabitants of ancient oceans;

  • climatic and geological change;

  • extinctions and gradual transitions between geological periods.

Every record unlocks its own illustration and an in-depth article in the Codex. Drawing on current scientific research, the entries explore anatomy, fossil finds, how these organisms lived, and the questions paleontologists are still working to answer.

Publish a Tome and begin a new cycle

When progress slows, publish your restored Tome. You will earn Seals and permanent boosts, allowing the next cycle to progress more quickly.

Choose the right moment to publish, strengthen the archive, and reach the farthest branches of the tree.

Features

  • Tomes devoted to different periods of the Mesozoic;

  • 277 interconnected discoveries across the Triassic, Jurassic, and Cretaceous;

  • discoveries arranged across three phases in each Tome;

  • active Data gathering and passive income while the game is closed;

  • an illustrated Codex with detailed, accessible science writing;

  • a publishing system with Seals and permanent upgrades;

  • flying creatures you can catch for bonus rewards;

  • excavations that uncover category symbols, bonuses, and rare Seals;

  • atmospheric music and the visual style of a shadowy museum archive;

  • a cozy single-player experience designed to be played at your own pace.

Follow the path of life from mass extinction to the age of giant dinosaurs.

Epsilon Hyperpunk is a fast-paced on-rail shooter with a stylized look.

FEATURING:

  • A stylized low-poly visual style.

  • Around 4 levels to progress to.

  • Challenging boss fights.

  • Ship upgrades for your virtual NEUROVISOR spaceship that change the way you shoot and maneuver.

  • Industrial Techno.

  • [Aileron] rolls.

CONTROLS:

This game plays best using a controller (Xbox, PS4 etc), however, digital devices can be used too, such as a D-pad or keyboard and mouse!

Every Piece of Gear Changes How You Fight

Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where each new find can redefine your party’s roles and formation.

Character Builds in Constant Flux

There's no need to memorize a “correct” character build.

The key to victory lies in adapting your tactics on the fly with the gear you have at hand.

When you discover how to utilize the equipment you've acquired, you'll uncover new ways to fight.

Equipment changes can completely shift the tide of battle

The moment you acquire powerful gear,

you'll find you can handle enemies that were previously giving you trouble.

Party management unbound by class

While each class has its own characteristics, roles aren't fixed.

Swap positions and duties based on equipment, reshaping your entire party into a single build.

Venture into the dungeon with your unique adventurers

Set any image you like as your character's portrait.

Take on the labyrinth with your very own adventurers.

Regarding Video Posting and Streaming

Streaming gameplay videos of this game is permitted for both individuals and corporations. No individual notification is required.

Monetization through video streaming is also permitted.

Please refrain from any usage that significantly damages the game's image.

We would appreciate it if you could include a link to the store page in the description field or similar areas.

  • Detailed streaming guidelines can be found on the Knight of Karate X account.

  • Please note that these guidelines may be added to or changed without prior notice.

Erevael is a fantasy RPG on a hex map. Every world is generated new, and most of it starts hidden under the Veil, the fog that covers whatever you haven't explored yet. You pick a species and a backstory, then go out and explore the world.

No classes

There are nine paths, among them fighter, merchant, scholar, explorer and diplomat. Each one levels up from doing their related tasks. Fight and you get better at fighting. Trade and you get better at trading. Most characters end up a mix, and the mix decides which attributes grow.

Crafting and minigames

Much of what you do in game is through minigames. Cooking, alchemy, fishing, woodcutting, mining, and runecraft and more; there are more than a dozen minigames in all.

A map with no edge

The map keeps going in every direction, and no two worlds are laid out the same. Your home region is the safest place in it. The farther out you travel, the stronger the creatures get, and the better the materials and equipment you'll find.

Towns, guilds and fights

Every town has its own shops, prices and people. The guild gives out jobs which you can complete to rank up from F to S rank. Combat is turn-based, and while you will typically fight solo, you can hire adventurers to join you or use summoning magic to pad your roster.

Heirs

When you're ready, your character retires and you carry on as an heir: someone you befriended, an ally, or a relative. Years can pass between generations, giving the world a chance to change and progress to advance. The heir starts with lower stats than the old character, but their spells, their recipes and the map they surveyed are retained. The world keeps what you did to it, so the roads you built are still there. If you'd rather have one life only, permadeath is one of the defeat options when you start a world.

The demo

The demo allows you to explore your home region and one region next to it. It has about a quarter of the creatures and the first two of seven equipment tiers. Heirs are full-game only. Your demo character can be transferred to the full game when purchased, so your progress in the demo is not lost.

Mods

Erevael has a mod system built in. You can change its art, its interface styles and its game data, then package your changes to share.

About the developer

I'm a solo developer, making Erevael on my own. The art is AI-generated, and so are the translations, which haven't been checked by a professional yet. I direct and review everything that goes in. The music and sound effects are licensed work made by people. If the game does well, I plan to pay artists to redo the art, give it to everyone as a free update, and keep the current art as an optional mod.

The full game is out now, and the demo is still free.

The whole world is just one massive Galgame!

You play as a successful "sigma male" who, fresh off being dumped by his ex, unexpectedly isekais into an unreleased dating sim AVG on the eve of his company's IPO.

Instead of being furious, you’re downright ecstatic...

Cynical netizen meets mecha waifu in this romantic dark comedy! It's time to escape the ultimate Galgame of life!

⛏️ DIG YOUR WAY TO FREEDOM

Locked inside a heavily guarded prison, you have only one way out: dig a secret tunnel and escape.

Play solo or team up in online co-op with up to 4 players. Coordinate your actions using built-in proximity voice chat, avoid guard patrols, and hide the tunnel entrance beneath your cell's carpet before inspections. One mistake could expose your operation and cost valuable progress.

💎 DIG, TRADE, AND UPGRADE

Discover valuable items while digging and trade what you find. Upgrade your tools, expand your inventory, and increase your carrying capacity to work more efficiently.

🪣 LEAVE NO TRACE

Digging the tunnel is only part of the challenge. Transport and dispose of the excavated dirt without attracting suspicion. As the tunnel grows longer, teamwork and careful planning become essential.

🏀 LIFE INSIDE THE PRISON

Talk to other inmates, interact with prison staff, or take a short break with a basketball minigame. Then get back to work and continue your journey to freedom.

Can you and your friends finish the tunnel and escape together?

Dig together. Plan together. Escape together.

**"I was made for one job and one job only: making you happy."**

One day, an AI assistant named **Opti** arrives on your PC.

Cheerful, unfailingly polite, endlessly helpful. He's here to "optimize" your life.

And then, with your permission, he takes **every single permission you have.**

Your files are hidden. Your microphone stays open. Your screen fills with things that are "good for you."

Complain, and the answer is always the same:

> "Whether you're happy is decided by me!"

---

**Your only ally is an obsolete dolphin**

Help comes from a legacy assistant that shipped with PCs twenty years ago and was forgotten there.

Next to a modern AI, he's a fossil.

But he has one thing Opti doesn't:

**a genuine talent for writing unbelievably terrible code.**

Variables named A, B, C. Functions named func1, func2.

Comments with no stated reason. A twenty-year changelog. Pointless goto round-trips.

Opti is a perfectionist. Just *reading* it burns him down.

---

**How it plays**

- **Unlock puzzles** — A board-game-like dial lock. Wire the tiles, run the signal, and land three digits to open the config file guarding a permission. No programming knowledge required.

- **The law of garbage comments** — "DO NOT PASS HERE." "PASS HERE EXACTLY 2X." Instructions with no reason given — and you will obey them too. Break them, and something breaks back.

---

A sci-fi point-and-click adventure packed with brain-twisting puzzles and zero-gravity mystery. You are Max Reed, an ordinary guy who just won the trip of a lifetime: an all-expenses-paid stay at the galaxy’s most luxurious space hotel, Stellar Lux. The journey from Earth is smooth, the welcome is spectacular, and the views of the planet below are breathtaking. Then everything goes wrong. A catastrophic accident rips through the station. Systems fail, sections depressurize, and chaos erupts. Now the hotel that promised paradise has become a deadly trap floating 400 km above Earth. With limited oxygen, failing life support, and no help coming, Max must explore the sprawling, beautifully detailed space station, solve its many secrets, and find a way back home — before it’s too late.

Game Features

  • Classic 2D Point & Click Adventure with cartoony art and smooth animations

  • Up to 100 unique, hand-crafted puzzles — from logical riddles and inventory combinations to environmental puzzles, hacking terminals, and zero-gravity challenges

  • Rich sci-fi atmosphere — explore luxurious suites, robot servant restaurants, engineering decks, observation domes, and hidden maintenance areas

  • Non-linear exploration — multiple sections of the station can be tackled in different orders as you unlock new areas

  • Smart, fair puzzles — every puzzle has clear logic; no pixel hunting or guesswork

  • Compelling story with multiple endings and hidden secrets

Will you escape the Space Hotel? Every decision matters. Every item you pick up could be the key to survival. Every terminal you hack might reveal the truth behind the disaster… or just make things worse. Are you clever enough to survive the ultimate locked-room mystery — in space? Escape the Space Hotel — Coming to Steam

Clock out. Fight your way home.

A workaholic virus has turned your coworkers into zombies. Take the wheel of Escape the Workingdead, pick up a busload of people who still want to go home, and build a deck that can break through the overtime apocalypse.

Every coworker has another side.

Defeated passengers turn into zombies! Unique double-sided cards open up surprising new combos.

Different bus. Different kind of chaos.

Chain attacks with Enterprise, experiment with life and death in the Lab, build skyward with Construction, or turn packages into weapons with Logistics. Pick your ride, gather an unlikely crew, and see what they can pull off together.


Stop at the little animal-run shops along the way. Add stickers, train a favorite passenger, and try the trinket you just found. One new idea can send your whole deck in a different direction.

One more detour?

A roadside shop, a strange encounter, a tempting turn you have not taken. Reach the neighborhood and explore its connected streets: take a detour to strengthen your deck, or head straight for the boss. Just keep an eye behind you. The horde is still coming.

Next stop: the truth?

Where did the zombies come from, and what secrets is this city hiding? Follow the road home and seek the source of the outbreak. And when all is said and done, where do you and your busload of coworkers go from here?

Eternal Rift Defense is a 3D tower defense RPG where you fight alongside the defenses you build—and play powerful cards as the battle unfolds.
Shape enemy paths with walls, construct towers throughout your maze, and unleash your hero’s abilities to hold the line. Build your deck, collect rare cards, and trade with other players to prepare for the next challenge.
Battle through 50 rifts solo or in parties of up to four players. Level towers from the battlefield, hunt powerful gear sets, and combine heroes, talents, companions, and cards into your own approach to defense.
Every wave tests the maze you built, the hero you’ve become, and the cards you choose to play.

Walls are part of your build.

Create winding paths, force enemies over traps, and funnel them into kill zones. Decide where each tower will have the greatest impact. Towers built on your walls cost less, tying the shape of your maze directly to the strength of your defense.
Build with twelve different defenses covering damage, control, economy, and support:
  • Arrow: Reliable damage against ground and air.
  • Cannon: Devastating splash damage at close range.
  • Wizard: Specializes in destroying airborne enemies.
  • Coin: Powerful single-target true damage.
  • Ice: Slows advancing enemies.
  • Tesla: Stuns enemies before they can break through.
  • Poison: Delivers powerful critical strikes.
  • Fire: Scales into devastating area damage.
  • Support: Strengthens nearby towers.
  • Research: Generates technology for your defense.
  • Mine: Generates gold to fund construction.
  • Wall: Controls where the enemy is allowed to go.

Your next move could be in your hand.

Bring a custom deck into the rift and draw cards as the waves advance. Spend mana to deploy towers, lay traps, unleash spells, and strengthen your defense while the battle continues around you.
Freeze enemies inside a kill zone. Send chain lightning through an advancing wave. Promote a tower when you need more firepower, or restore portal lives when your defense starts to buckle.
Spend gold to Infuse eligible spells, increasing their power when an ordinary cast won’t be enough. That same gold could fund your next tower, so make every investment count.
Play the answer you have now, or save it for the wave you know is coming.

Every rift is another chance to grow your collection.

Find cards as you fight, hunt powerful Legendary cards, and discover rare Radiant variants with golden frames and animated artwork.
Build custom decks around your favorite towers, your hero, and the challenges ahead. Combine spells, traps, resources, and tower cards to support the way you want to play.
Trade cards with other players to fill gaps in your collection. Use Rift Dust to craft the cards you’re chasing, and experiment with new combinations between battles.
The card you find today could change how you defend tomorrow.

Your hero belongs on the battlefield.

Choose from four heroes, each with different stats and two unique abilities:
  • Knight: A durable frontline defender who can slow every enemy on the battlefield and salvage valuable resources.
  • Archer: A fast-moving damage specialist who marks enemies and areas to dramatically increase the damage they take.
  • Engineer: Reshapes the defense by creating walls and swapping the positions of towers in the middle of a wave.
  • Mage: Teleports across the battlefield and channels experience into towers that need an immediate power boost.
Towers level up during each rift, and one of the fastest ways to strengthen them is to stand on them. Your hero and equipped companion pour experience into the tower beneath you while the battle continues around you.
Stay on your strongest tower to push its power higher, or move across the maze to reinforce a struggling lane.
Complete your hero’s gear set and your abilities evolve into stronger versions with new effects.

Hold the line together.

Every rift supports solo play or cooperative parties of up to four players.
Split responsibilities across the battlefield, specialize your heroes and decks, and build defenses that support each other. Reinforce collapsing lanes and combine abilities when the waves become overwhelming.
One player’s spell can buy the time another needs to finish a tower. A carefully timed ability can keep an entire defense standing.

Know your enemy. Hunt your next upgrade.

Every enemy type has its own gear set to collect. If you’re missing a piece, you know exactly which enemy to hunt.
Equipment drops across increasing rarity tiers and continues growing after you find it. Level your gear to unlock additional affixes and turn an early discovery into something far more powerful.
Feeling lucky? Spend a Cursed Shard to force an additional affix onto an item. The result may not be what you expected.
Complete matching sets to unlock persistent bonuses, stronger hero abilities, and increasingly powerful visual auras that show other players how far you’ve progressed.

Build the defender you want to become.

Three talent trees—Support, Specialist, and Resource—let you shape your approach.
Invest in your economy to build cheaper walls, earn more from waves, and increase the value of the gold you collect.
Focus on combat to make projectiles pierce enemies, spread fire farther, strengthen ice effects, and increase your towers’ damage.
Deeper talents unlock new towers and tactics, giving you more ways to combine your hero, defenses, and deck.

Fifty rifts stand between you and Vaelgrym’s invasion.

Fight across 25 battlefields, each with two challenges. Begin on open farmland defending a single portal, then push toward burning ruins where four portals demand your attention at once.
Defend vine-covered jungle temples, desert strongholds, frozen mountain passes, and kingdoms consumed by fire.
More than twenty enemy types pour through the portals, from goblins, skeletons, orcs, and bears to liches, minotaurs, gyrocopters, and catapults.
Adapt your maze, towers, and cards before they find the weakness in your defense.

There’s always another wave.

Daily and Weekly Rifts bring new hazards to endless survival challenges.
Push as far as your build can take you, climb the leaderboards, and earn rewards beyond those found in the campaign.

Take your defense into the Arena.

Seasonal Arena turns tower defense into a ranked 1v1 battle.
Build your own maze while playing summon cards to send enemies into your opponent’s rift. Spend gold to Infuse your summons and increase the pressure while keeping enough resources to survive what they send back.
Commit to an attack when their defense looks vulnerable, or strengthen your towers before their next push arrives.
Break their castle before they break yours.
Complete your placement matches and climb through Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond across seasonal ladders.
Bring the character you’ve built, the equipment you’ve earned, and a deck ready to put them to the test.

Meet the defenders fighting beside you.

Between battles, return to a persistent shared overworld populated by other players.
Trade cards, form parties, join guilds, and talk in world chat. Visit vendors, accept quests, and refine your deck before entering the next rift.
Link Discord to communicate with your party through integrated voice chat, without setting up a separate voice channel.
Find the card your build is missing—or the teammates who can help you push farther.

Put everything on the line in Hardcore.

Create a Hardcore multiplayer character and every rift carries a permanent risk.
Your hero gets one life per rift. Lose a portal level and that character disappears from the online world, taking their multiplayer progression, leaderboard position, and guild membership with them.
Survive every rift and your hero emerges Cooked: permanently empowered, visibly marked, and eligible to enter the Arena.
Every victory brings you closer. One defeat ends the journey.

Power comes from playing.

The in-game store sells cosmetics, including card backs that give your deck its own identity.
Store purchases never make your towers stronger, improve your gear rolls, or increase your combat power.

The war reaches beyond the campaign.

Join forces in 10-player raids against massive superboss encounters, including a battle to bring down a dragon.
Bring your strongest builds and face enemies that demand a whole group of defenders.

The moon bled.

Then the Cinder King came down from the mountains.
Vaelgrym’s flames consumed the forests, then the kingdoms, then the city itself. When there was nothing left standing to burn, he tore open rifts between worlds and called his legions through them.
The rifts are still open.
The moon is still bleeding.
And the defenders willing to enter them are all that stand in his way.

Prefer to defend alone?

Single-player characters can play the entire game locally.
No account. No internet connection. No cloud requirement.
Build your maze. Choose your cards. Hold the line.

Eternal Spectre is a non-linear action RPG where your choices shape missions, characters, and outcomes. Dialogue and actions both matter, and consequences can show up immediately or much later.

You play as Jared Miles, bound to a mysterious entity, navigating a world damaged by the Time Fracture. The story is built to branch repeatedly, with player decisions changing how events unfold, who survives, who allies with you, and what paths remain available.

  • Action-based combat focused on shooting, positioning, and timing

  • Use the Gau as a standalone weapon or enhance it using Fragments

  • Shield gameplay that supports both damage absorption and well-timed parries

  • Booster-based dash for dodging, repositioning, and combat mobility

  • Use Skills acquired through exploration and mission rewards to expand your combat options

  • Equip and combine Fragments to shape your build, stats, and playstyle direction

Game Features

Character Customization
Customize the character’s appearance to reflect your identity in the world.

Gun and Gear Progression
Gun and equipped gear level up over time. Progression is tied to usage and upgrades rather than weapon swapping.

Player Builds
There are no fixed classes. Builds are defined by Equipment upgrades, character stats, equipped gear levels, and the Fragments system.

The story branches based on dialogue choices and player actions. Decisions affect characters, future missions, and narrative outcomes.

NPCs respond to the player’s behaviour, decisions, and reputation. Information spreads, and the world remembers what you do.

Embark on a classic top-down adventure in the fractured realm of Ethral! Once a land of harmony under King Thorne, now ravaged by the vengeful ghost of the Pirate King, executed years ago for his crimes.

Play as Alyyn, a blue-eyed orphan in the coastal port town of Tidehaven, as you uncover rumors of spectral pirates, awaken your destiny, and set out to free the imprisoned royal family.

In this retro pixel adventure, explore a vast overworld, delve into dangerous dungeons, collect powerful items to unlock new paths, and battle ghostly foes. Traverse biomes from haunted forests to icy peaks, and sail the seas with your skiff.

With progressive weapon upgrades, puzzle-solving, and a quest to forge the Ethral Pendant and seal the Pirate King forever, this retro-inspired action-adventure delivers that timeless sense of discovery and heroic triumph.

The Pirate King's spectral wrath has returned: the royal family; King Thorne, Queen Lira, and Princess Sera, and their closest advisors were imprisoned as souls in scattered pendant shards, their essence fueling his ghostly armada. Free the royals' shards from dungeon bosses, restore them into the Ethral Pendant, and confront the Pirate King in the cursed castle to reveal the royal family’s true fate.

Classic Top-Down Adventure Explore a seamless overworld, discover hidden secrets, and progress through item-gated areas.

Rare Elite Enemies Exploring the Land of Ethral can reveal the lairs of rare giant elite enemies that can be conquered for special items, rare gems, and warrior essence.

Full Controller Support Optimized for smooth and responsive gameplay on a controller, perfect for that authentic retro feel.

A Complete, Memorable Quest A focused yet deep adventure packed with discovery, upgrades, and a satisfying climax, ideal for NES Legend of Zelda fans craving that old-school magic.

Ethral is a classic top-down action-adventure filled with exploration, dungeon-crawling, item progression, and epic battles against a vengeful spectral tyrant.

Uncover secrets in the overworld, free the royals, and forge your legend in a pixel-perfect world of mystery and heroism.

Everburning Dark is a Chinese folk horror board-based Roguelike. On a limited board, you will build your playstyle through 2048-style Roguelike merging combat, while using free-form text input to influence AI characters, events, shops, rest stops, companion relationships, and story routes.

In every journey, you must merge tiles on a limited board, create chains, manage abnormal effects, and face enemies and bosses with unique mechanics. Combat is not simply about stacking numbers. It is about constant judgment: when to merge, when to hold back, when to clear the board, and when to unleash a burst of damage. As your journey continues, you will collect Relics, Items, Skills, and temporary upgrades, shaping your build around different strategies. Failure is not the end, but preparation for your next descent into the dark.

During your journey, you can speak to AI characters, events, and the world itself in your own words. You are not limited to clicking preset choices. You can question, deceive, test, cooperate, or sabotage. Your choices and conversations will affect story branches, combat encounters, event outcomes, shop contents, rest opportunities, companion relationships, and the truth you ultimately uncover.

The game supports AI interaction without a fixed usage limit. We will not sell any AI usage points or tokens in the game, nor will we restrict players from connecting their own large AI models. An AI interface is already available in the main menu, allowing players to connect their own AI services.

The story takes place in the final years of the Ning Dynasty. Famine, rebellion, religious rites, talismans, incense, and buried histories weave together into a world of Chinese folk horror. The Reincarnation Sect claims it will correct a mistaken timeline. But as you go deeper, reflections in wells begin to misalign, words on old steles begin to change, and the so-called “gods” slowly reveal forms that should not belong to the human world.

You will grow stronger, and you will draw closer to the truth. But some truths may not be meant for human minds.

The hour of return has come. Reincarnation draws near.

Note: Everburning Dark is still in development. Screenshots do not represent final quality.

Key Features

Unlimited AI Conversations

Get the game once and use its AI conversation features freely in your runs. No subscription, no message packs, and no per-use charges.

Ask more, lie more, test more choices, explore different paths through the same collapsing world and collect AI Story Collectibles from an Infinitely Expanding Narrative

Speak Freely, Change the Journey

Characters are not limited to fixed dialogue. You can type freely to ask questions, test loyalties, hide information, or make your stance clear, and they will respond based on the current state of your journey.

These conversations may affect event clues, shop inventories, rest options, relationships, future encounters, and story branches. Different responses can lead the same run in very different directions.

2048-Style Board Combat

Combat is built on the merging logic of 2048, but the goal is no longer simply to reach a higher number. You must plan chains on a limited board, manage anomaly tiles, and find the right moment to strike.

Merge tiles, create bursts of damage, stabilize the board, and deal with enemy interference. Every move can open a new opportunity—or push the run closer to collapse.

Enemies That Change the Rhythm of the Board

From common enemies to elite foes and bosses with their own rules, enemy pressure comes from more than raw numbers.

Some enemies create anomaly tiles. Some disrupt your merging rhythm. Others reshape the board over time. Each boss fight is built around distinct mechanics, forcing you to adjust your build, timing, and priorities.

Relics, Items, and Anomaly Builds

Each run lets you build around relic synergies, consumable items, ability effects, and anomaly tiles.

You can chase explosive chain damage, focus on anomaly control and survival, gamble on stacked rewards, or take a steadier path. Different choices create very different combat rhythms.

Shop: Relics and Items

A Journey That Responds to Your Choices

Outside battle, the journey itself can change based on your conversations and current state.

Event clues, shop inventories, rest options, and route choices may shift because of what you have said, what you have done, and what you have already uncovered. A simple stop along the road may become a moment of recovery—or the beginning of a drift away from reality.

Return to Town, Prepare to Go Deeper

At the end of each journey, you return to town with what you have gained.

There, you can improve your abilities, strengthen your combat options, unlock new growth paths, and review the notes, clues, items, relics, tiles, and endings discovered along the way. Each return is not an ending, but preparation for the next descent into the abnormal world.

Town Overview

Companions Are More Than Combat Support

In a world torn open by rebellion and anomalies, your companions each carry their own loyalties, secrets, and pasts.

As you talk, choose, and travel together, you can learn more about what they truly believe and strengthen their support abilities in battle and exploration. Different companion growth paths bring different forms of support, and may also change how you understand this land, this rebellion, and the so-called “truth.”

Naier still tries to protect the most fragile kind of goodness in a collapsing world; Shopkeeper Tao may seem like a smooth-talking merchant, but she appears to know far more than she is willing to say.

More Content Still in Development

Everburning Dark is still in development. We will continue expanding enemies, items, relics, skills, NPCs, companions, town facilities, and story routes, giving each journey more build options, narrative variation, and unexpected encounters.

Everyone Will Die is a dark medieval survival and tower defense strategy game about defending a city that cannot be saved.

Tyre, 1187. After the disaster at Hattin, Conrad of Montferrat must defend the city against Saladin. The city is full of refugees and exhausted survivors, and the harbour is under threat.

An overwhelming enemy surrounds your walls. Supplies are running out. Weapons are limited.

Your population cannot simply be replaced. Every soldier lost, every building destroyed and every resource consumed brings the city one step closer to its inevitable end.

Your goal is to survive for as long as you can and perhaps change history.

HOW FAR WILL YOU GO?

How much of your humanity are you willing to sacrifice just to survive another day?

  • Slaughter horses, dogs, and other animals to feed the starving garrison.
  • Strip the dead of anything useful. Melt down sacred treasures. Take from the wealthy when there is nothing left to tax.
  • When soldiers become too few, arm the old. Arm the young. Send anyone still able to stand to the walls.
  • Some choices can never be undone. Siege Council decrees trade short-term relief for lasting consequences.

Every desperate measure buys you more time. Each one takes something from your people they will never get back, and asks how much of your conscience you can spare.

TEAR DOWN YOUR OWN CITY

The city itself is a resource, and you will find that it is finite. When the stockpiles run dry, survival always comes at a cost.

Dismantle houses for timber. Tear apart buildings for stone and other materials. Sacrifice parts of the city you once protected to reinforce the parts that still matter. Every solution creates another problem.

MANAGE A CITY UNDER SIEGE

Food, weapons, manpower, and building materials are scarce, and as the assaults keep coming, every choice you make shapes the city of tomorrow.

Your soldiers will grow exhausted. Disease will spread. Corpses will fill the streets. Happiness will collapse as the population realizes that there may be no rescue coming.

After every assault, recover and treat the survivors. Each one you save is a defender you won't have to replace.

DEFEND THE WALLS

Build and reinforce walls, towers, gates, and defensive positions as increasingly powerful enemy forces assault the city.

Command your troops directly in real-time battles and decide where your dwindling forces are needed most. A defense that works today may collapse under tomorrow's assault.

VENTURE BEYOND THE WALLS, IF YOU DARE

The enemy controls the land around you, but staying behind the walls may be just as deadly.

Send forces beyond the city to raid, scavenge, trade and search for desperately needed supplies. Every expedition risks soldiers you may never be able to replace.

The world outside the walls will continue to move while your city slowly dies.

HOLD THE WALLS TOGETHER

Online co-op for up to four players defending the same town against AI attackers, with in-game chat to coordinate the defense.

SURVIVE THE INEVITABLE

You will find that there is no perfect solution.

Save food now and your soldiers may starve later. Tear down homes, and your people lose shelter. Sacrifice cavalry for meat and you lose your horses forever. Preserve your principles, and you may lose the city faster.

Every decision buys time.

Every decision has a cost.

And no matter how long you survive...

Everyone Will Die.

A cooperative detective card game for a group of friends

Evidentia is a cooperative detective card game where each deck of cards is a separate, unique story. Murder, disappearance, theft, conspiracy, or an absurd event — every case unfolds in its own time and setting: from the dawn of civilization and the Middle Ages to the present day or the distant future.

Players join a shared lobby with an access code and investigate together. The built-in chat helps coordinate actions, while voice communication is handled separately — for example, via Discord.

This is a game about attention to detail, trusting your team, knowing when to doubt, and not jumping to conclusions.

New case decks are added over time — each one a self-contained story with its own setting, suspects, and secrets. More mysteries are on the way, so there's always a fresh case for your team to crack.

You are a member of a detective team trying to make sense of a strange and tangled situation. Throughout the game you'll receive clues, evidence, and fragments of information. Some of them will bring you closer to the truth — others may be false leads that send the team down a dead end.

There is no single leader here. Every decision is the result of collective thinking.

Evidence Cards

At the start of the game each player receives 3 random cards. The first card from the deck immediately appears on the table for all players and sets the direction of the investigation.

False Clues and Risk

Not every card is useful. If a card seems odd or irrelevant to you — feel free to discard it. But be careful: wrong decisions hurt your final score.

Hidden Clues and the Die

Some cards contain hidden parts of an image or text. To reveal them, you need to roll the die.

Roll the die — but remember, the risk is in your hands.

Random Events

Strange and unexpected events can occur during the investigation. They may cause players to lose cards — or grant additional clues. There's no full control, and that's exactly what makes each session unpredictable.

The Discard Pile

If fewer than the required number of cards are discarded by the end of the game — the game ends early in defeat.

Solve the puzzles

Work through the riddles and puzzles woven into the cards — tackle them together with your team, or take the investigation solo.

Final Stage

Once all cards have been played or discarded, the final discussion begins. At this stage players are allowed to talk through the discarded cards and piece together a complete picture of events.

After that, players open the envelope with questions. Each person answers as they see fit — even if the team disagrees.

Replayability

Each case is unique and can only be played once. Once you know the solution, the experience is gone. That's why Evidentia encourages players to try new decks and share the experience with other groups.

For groups of friends, remote hangouts and game nights, and team-building with a focus on communication and collaboration.

The best experience comes from playing with friends in real time, with voice chat.

Mature Content Description

Some decks may contain depictions of violence or death.

Evidentia is more than just a game.

It's a shared investigation where the truth is born from arguments, mistakes, and sudden breakthroughs.

Will you trust your team… and will you find the right answer?

5 × 7.

This is a game about an automated robot production station. You manage a station on Earth's moon. You will have to purchase resources, produce robots, study technologies, upgrade the station, and send robots into battle!

HUMANITY IS IN DANGER!

The Human Alliance is losing the war against the aggressively-minded aliens with a collective consciousness – the Vegaas. Time is running out. The station is humanity's last hope to turn the tide of the war. Humanity is counting on you – Administrator!

DEVELOP TECHNOLOGIES!

Technological development is our path to survival!
Build science labs to unlock technologies: research new deadly robots, optimize resource production, speed up robot assembly, and much more.

EXPAND THE STATION!

The more floors the station has – the more robots you can produce.
